# Temple Scroll Column 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 9 | **Condition:** Fragmentary; Wood Offering Festival continues

---

**9:1** [...] on-the-third day Simeon and-Benjamin [...]

**9:2** [...] on-the-fourth day Issachar and-Zebulun [...]

**9:3** [...] on-the-fifth day Gad and-Asher [...]

**9:4** [...] on-the-sixth day Dan and-Naphtali [...]

**9:5** [...] and-they-shall-bring wood for-the-altar [...]

**9:6** [...] each tribe shall-bring [...] on-the-day of-its-lot [...]

**9:7** [...] and-the-priests and-the-Levites shall-place [it] upon the-fire [...]

**9:8** [...] upon the-altar of-the-burnt-offering [...]

**9:9** [...] this [is] the-day of-the-wood-[offering ...] a-statute for-ever [...]

**9:10** [...] for-your-generations [...] before the-LORD [...]

**9:11** [...] there-shall-not cease fire upon the-altar [...]

**9:12** [...] continually it-shall-burn [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 9 continues the Wood Offering Festival schedule: day three (Simeon and Benjamin), day four (Issachar and Zebulun), day five (Gad and Asher), day six (Dan and Naphtali). Note: the tribal pairing here differs from Column 8 line 7, where Benjamin is paired with Joseph's sons on day two. Some scholars emend 9:1 to read "Reuben" instead of repeating Benjamin. The perpetual fire commandment (lines 11-12) echoes Leviticus 6:6 [Eng. 6:13].*
